messages:
Sam: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
Sam: Did: triaged the spike in 503s from eu-west yesterday, narrowed to batching backlog on dedicated nodes. Filed INC-4218.
Sam: Blocker: still seeing flaky warmup on one GPU pool; I need help validating a kernel fallback test.
Sam: Today: patch the autoscaler cooldown and test the fallback path, will open a small PR.
Alex: saw INC-4218, thanks. re: kernel fallback — I can pair after my standup (30m).
Priya: heads-up: alerts page has a duplicate rule firing for the same latency window, created a ticket SRE-287.
Priya: patch landed to dedupe rule in alerts-config repo, staging deploy green.
Miguel: I can run the kernel fallback job on the suspect hosts, once PR is ready ping me.
Infra-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded for alerts-config (rev d4c3b2) — 3 services updated :rocket:
Jordan: small note — oncall rotation this week: Sam covers Thu early, Alex covers Fri overnight. @Sam please confirm if you want the paging threshold relaxed during your window.
Sam: yes, please keep a small backoff: move paging threshold +1m for token-service during my Thu window, I'll monitor.
Sam: Alex/Priya — I'll drop the repro steps and a short log snippet into INC-4218.
Alex: ack, I'll look at the logs you add. If the kernel fallback reduces tail latencies, we can roll to prod as a canary.
Priya: also adding a brief runbook step to INC-4218: if warmup fails, run `kubectl exec -n inference -c serving -- /usr/local/bin/kv-warmup --force` then incrementally restart pool.
Miguel: FYI I ran `ssh gpu-12 && tail -n 200 /var/log/serving/runtime.log | grep KVCache` — saw timeout entries around 02:14UTC, shared output in the ticket.
Sam: thanks Miguel, that log helped. I'll try the `--force` warmup on staging and report back.
Jordan: quick scheduling note: can we slot a 30m post-mortem sync tomorrow if INC-4218 looks like a rollout issue? want to capture metrics/correlate autoscaler changes.
Sam: good idea — tentatively +1 for 11:00UTC tomorrow, will confirm after tests.
Alex: small PR ping: PR#342 in infra-ops needs a review (batching tweaks) — low risk but touches hot path.
Sam: adding to my queue after kernel tests.
Infra-bot: pager-duty: INC-4218 auto-assigned to Sam (priority P2) — escalation timer 2h.
Priya: thanks all, I'll keep the alerts dedupe monitor running and post if duplicate firing stops. :thumbsup:
Sam: wrapping — will update thread when I have staging results. If anyone has spare cycles, please glance at PR#342 and INC-4218 logs.
Alex: roger that.
Miguel: standing by for the PR or a ping to run the fallback job.
Jordan: noted, will prep the post-mortem template if needed.
Sam: cheers everyone.
